# UniqAI open-source tools: free AI video and image prompt tools

> Five free tools from UniqAI (https://uniqai.app/), an AI photo, video and chat app. They write, check and collect prompts for AI video and image models, check Russian text for stock AI phrasing, run in the browser and are open source. Curated by Vlad Yasinski (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vlad-yasinski-ua5er/).

## Tools

- [Video Director](https://uniqaiapp.github.io/video-director/): Storyboard builder. Turn a one-line idea into a timed storyboard and a paste-ready AI video prompt. Repo: https://github.com/uniqaiapp/video-director
- [AI Video Prompt Gallery](https://uniqaiapp.github.io/awesome-ai-video-prompts/): Prompt gallery. Search real AI video prompts, filter by model and copy the one you need. Repo: https://github.com/uniqaiapp/awesome-ai-video-prompts
- [UGC Ad Director](https://uniqaiapp.github.io/ugc-ad-director/): Ad script checker. Check a UGC ad script before you spend money generating it. Repo: https://github.com/uniqaiapp/ugc-ad-director
- [no-plastic](https://uniqaiapp.github.io/no-plastic/): Image prompt checker. Stop AI portraits from looking plastic by fixing the prompt first. Repo: https://github.com/uniqaiapp/no-plastic
- [deslop-ru](https://uniqaiapp.github.io/deslop-ru/): Russian text checker. Find the phrases that make a Russian draft sound machine-written. Repo: https://github.com/uniqaiapp/deslop-ru

## Other repositories

- [uniqaiapp on GitHub](https://github.com/uniqaiapp): video-director, awesome-ai-video-prompts, ugc-ad-director, ai-video-pricing, no-plastic, suno-producer, model-router, token-diet, skill-shrinker, deslop-ru
- [HablaMusic suno-latin-producer](https://hablamusic.github.io/suno-latin-producer/): sister project, Suno prompts and lyrics for Latin genres

## Facts

- UniqAI runs Nano Banana for images and Kling and Veo for video.
- Tool notes for other models (Wan, Seedance, Runway, Flux, Midjourney, SDXL and others) are written for those models, which UniqAI does not run.
- Code is MIT licensed; prompt collections and vocabularies are CC BY 4.0.
- The tools run in the browser. Only anonymous page views and button clicks are counted, never the text you type.
